slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: Continental report on the October 2016 APAI-CRVS self-reported monitoring round. Cabo Verde appears only in the annex's score bands: digitization of the civil registration system 65-79% (one of 7 countries in that band), overall system 65-79%, legal framework 80-100%. The composite does not say which events Cabo Verde's offices capture electronically, how, or in how many offices, and names no system, so no fact.
